headline: With the group stage still unfolding, the seeding still points to Spain lifting the trophy over Argentina.

rounds.label: Round of 32
rounds.note: Seeds should mostly hold in the Round of 32; the tightest tie on paper is Colombia v Croatia, the likeliest upset.

rounds.label: Round of 16
rounds.note: The Round of 16 narrows the field — Germany v France is the tie most likely to buck the ranking.

rounds.label: Quarter-finals
rounds.note: Quarter-final weekend thins the contenders: France, Spain, England, Argentina are projected through to the semis.

rounds.label: Semi-finals
rounds.note: Spain, Argentina are tipped to come out of the semi-finals and meet for the title.

rounds.label: Final
rounds.note: Spain v Argentina — the two highest-ranked sides left; Spain edges it on pedigree.
